original_ai_output.title_zh: 南苏丹西赤道州警方追捕枪击足球裁判的嫌疑人
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 南苏丹西赤道州Mvolo县Barboi村一场足球比赛中，一名球员在被裁判出示黄牌并罚下场后，据称取来AK-47步枪向裁判头部开枪。警方正在追捕在逃嫌疑人，裁判在当地医院接受治疗。当局表示该地区无网络覆盖，仍在收集信息，裁判身份、伤情及事件完整情况尚未独立确认。

location.raw_text: Barboi Village in Mvolo County’s Kokori Payam, Western Equatoria State

key_facts.fact: 南苏丹西赤道州警方正在追捕一名涉嫌枪击足球裁判的嫌疑人
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The police in Western Equatoria State are pursuing a suspect who reportedly shot and injured a football referee in the head

key_facts.fact: 事件起因是裁判出示黄牌并将一名球员罚下场后发生争执
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the incident followed a dispute after the referee showed a player a yellow card and ordered him off the pitch

key_facts.fact: 该球员据称取来AK-47步枪向裁判头部开枪
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The player allegedly left the field, collected an AK-47 rifle and shot the referee in the head
The player who shot the referee is still at large

key_facts.fact: 裁判在当地医院接受治疗
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the referee is receiving treatment at a local hospital

key_facts.fact: 当局称该地区无网络覆盖，仍在收集信息
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: authorities were still gathering information because the area was outside network coverage

uncertainties: 嫌疑人身份尚未确认，据称在逃
裁判身份与当前伤情尚未独立确认
事件完整情况尚未独立查明
目前仅单一来源（Radio Tamazuj）报道，缺乏交叉验证
